title: Declare personas before signing in
when: Test needs authenticated behavior or more than one account
need: Declare personas and each target origin with signed-in probes in browser-control. A mission may set method_config.browser_identities, such as ["operator"]; its list wins. Otherwise dispatch supplies project identities covering the immutable target origin, and the walker picks the needed account. Selected identities use managed setup, verification and steps even without installing Yoke; expired sites return a human gate naming identity, site and account. API/CLI credentials stay separate.
surface: Browser scenario method configuration → browser-identities reference.
gap: Live signed-in prod mission proof remains a release obligation.
review: Source regressions cover explicit case lists, project personas covering the target origin, uncovered sites, managed browser selection and public-bundle database forwarding.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json
